questions.q: Who is credited with teaching that sales can be learned?
questions.why: Brian Tracy argues anyone can learn selling.

questions.q: What tool helps salespeople tap their subconscious according to the book?
questions.why: A to-do list is described as a subconscious tool.

questions.q: What habit does the book suggest for continuous learning?
questions.why: It recommends learning one new thing a day.

questions.q: Why should salespeople ask customers questions?
questions.why: Questions help tailor the pitch to customer needs.

questions.q: Which mindset does Brian Tracy promote for sales success?
questions.why: The book states sales skills can be learned, not innate.
